title: Eleven Weeks of Watching
subtitle: 豆类与粮食 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 豆类与粮食（生活与学习·饮食与烹饪）
meta: 主题语境：豆类与粮食（生活与学习·饮食与烹饪）　|　核心词汇：bean　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bean 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandmother planted ① a bean in a tin on the window ledge and watched it for eleven weeks, and my mother said the watching was the whole of the crop. The ② bean, meaning the seed and not the plant, was eaten in June and was the only thing in the house that year that had been planted on purpose; a bean, she said, is the only food that is counted before it exists.

Every ③ bean in that garden was sown on a Friday, and the ④ bean by the fence, meaning the one saved for seed and not either of those, was the only one that was never eaten. A bean, my grandfather said, is nine parts patience and one part a stick you remembered to cut; my grandmother said the patience is the part you cannot buy.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bean was the whole of the shop, meaning the tins and not the seed. The ⑥ bean, meaning the thing you buy and not any of that, is the only food in a cupboard that nobody plans to eat tonight; a bean, he said, is either something you plant or the only word that means both a seed and an emergency. She said the emergency is the honest half.

By 1961 the ⑦ bean had become a word in an argument about the price, and the price had become an argument about the weather. The ⑧ bean of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was eleven weeks of watching and one eaten pod; a bean, she said, is either the seed in the tin or the reason you learned to wait for rain. He said the waiting never got any easier.

The ⑨ bean I remember is the one by the fence, which was saved every year and never planted. A ⑩ bean, my mother said in 1964, is the only crop that improves by being kept; every bean, she said, is an emergency that has agreed to look like a seed. She said the seed was never the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 豆（指那粒种子，与植株相对）
C. 固定搭配：plant a bean 种一粒豆
D. n. 豆（指园里每一粒）
E. n. 豆（指篱边那一粒／那一株）
F. n. 豆（指罐头里那些豆子）
G. n. 豆（抽象：买来的那种食物）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bean in a tin on the window ledge
The bean, meaning the seed and not the plant
bean was the whole of the shop
The bean, meaning the thing you buy
the bean had become a word in an argument about the price
The bean of the whole thing

answers.why: plant a bean 意为“种一粒豆”，1947 年祖母在窗台上的一个铁皮罐里种了一粒豆，看了它十一个星期。
bean 意为“豆”，指那粒种子而不是植株，六月被吃掉，是那一年屋里唯一故意种出来的东西。
bean 指园里每一粒豆，那个园里每一粒都是星期五种的。
bean 指篱边那一粒（留作种子的那一粒），是唯一从没被吃掉的。
bean 意为“豆”，指罐头里那些豆子，父亲说 bean 就是那家店的全部。
bean 为抽象用法，指买来的那种食物，是碗柜里唯一没人打算今晚就吃掉的东西。
bean 意为“豆”，到 1961 年这个 bean 成了一场关于价格的争吵里的一个词。
bean 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一个星期的守候和一只被吃掉的豆荚。
bean 意为“豆”，我记得的是篱边那一粒，年年被留下来，却从没被种下去。
bean 为抽象总称，母亲说豆是唯一会因为被留着而变好的庄稼。
